summary: Lets Metro give up old water and sewer pipes, seven fire hydrant assemblies, seven manholes and easements, and accept new water and sewer pipes, eight fire hydrant assemblies, 27 manholes and easements. This covers 30 properties on McClurkin Avenue, Emmett Avenue, Trevecca Avenue, Gallatin Avenue, Strouse Avenue and Douglas Avenue, also known as Lincoln Tech, at no cost to Metro.
